prompt: bump Selene's pinned version in rokit.toml to the latest release
texts:
I haven't changed anything. I can't look up Selene's latest release from here, because I have no shell or web access, and I won't guess a version number.

`rokit.toml` currently pins `selene = "Kampfkarren/selene@0.29.0"`.

You can get the version either of these ways:
- **Tell me the version.** Check https://github.com/Kampfkarren/selene/releases and give me the number. I'll edit the pin.
- **Run it yourself.** `rokit add Kampfkarren/selene@X.Y.Z` writes the pin to `rokit.toml`.

Once the pin changes, `adopting.md` says to read the release notes between 0.29.0 and the new version and rerun `selene` on the project. If the project has a selene config or guards tied to 0.29.0, those need re-review.
